line: A check said the sound landed. It didn't.
A check ran before the fix it watched.
A script proved a file existed. It was empty.
No tool caught any of it. A human did.
So every check now watches the one before it.
That's the only reason this one shipped clean.
The fix: break it on purpose, confirm it catches the break, only then trust it.
Follow for setups that actually works.
